paragraphs: Hyman cites R' Elazar ben Antigonus: [compare Shabbat 150b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.150b.11) (Hyman cites 103b); Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus: [Mishnah Sheviit 6:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Sheviit.6.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The second patronymic is shortened to ב״א and expanded from the Antigonus heading.

The linked Shabbat passage gives Rabbi Elazar ben Antigonus transmitting a ruling in Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov’s name. [Heilprin’s Elazar entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=536&lang=en) cites 150b. The linked Mishnah names Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus, also indexed by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1454&lang=en). These attest two names; the earlier 103b locator is Hyman’s.
